settings.hero_title: We'd Love to Hear From You
settings.hero_subtitle: Whether you're planning your first build, booking a workshop, or just want to say hello — real people answer every message.

settings.question: Do I need experience to build a bamboo bike?
settings.answer: Not at all. 95% of our builders have never built anything like this before. Our workshops include full guidance, and our kits come with detailed video tutorials.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: UK: 3-5 business days. Europe: 7-10 days. International: 10-14 days. You'll receive tracking as soon as your kit ships.

settings.question: Can I visit the workshop?
settings.answer: Yes! We love visitors. Pop by appointment or come see a workshop in action — just get in touch first.

settings.question: Do you offer group discounts?
settings.answer: Yes, for groups of 3 or more. Contact us with your numbers and we'll put together a quote.
